headers.name: cdn-pullzone
headers.source: https://bunny.net/docs/cdn/cdn-acceleration (cdn-pullzone, the Pull Zone handling the request: if these headers are present, the content is served through bunny.net's CDN), and observed on 2026-11-16 on bunny.net, www.innogames.com and cdn.bsky.app

headers.name: cdn-requestcountrycode
headers.source: https://bunny.net/docs/cdn/cdn-acceleration (cdn-requestcountrycode, among the headers whose presence shows the content is served through bunny.net's CDN), and observed on 2026-11-16 on bunny.net, www.innogames.com and cdn.bsky.app

cookies.name: bunny_shield
cookies.source: https://bunny.net/docs/shield/cookies (set by Bunny Shield once the visitor has completed its JavaScript proof-of-work challenge)

cookies.name: bunny_shield_chk
cookies.source: https://bunny.net/docs/shield/cookies (checksum that protects the bunny_shield cookie)

cookies.name: bunny_shield_id
cookies.source: https://bunny.net/docs/shield/cookies (identifier of the browser session for Bunny Shield's bot detection)

cookies.name: bunny_shield_bd
cookies.source: https://bunny.net/docs/shield/cookies (fingerprint of the browser environment for Bunny Shield's bot detection)

server.source: https://bunny.net/docs/cdn/troubleshooting/run-traceroute (every response from Bunny CDN has a Server header BunnyCDN-{PoP Code}-{Server-ID}), and observed on 2026-11-16 on bunny.net (BunnyCDN-FR1-1216), www.innogames.com and cdn.bsky.app

cname.source: https://bunny.net/docs/cdn/custom-hostname (a custom hostname is a CNAME to yourzone.b-cdn.net), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.innogames.com (backend-www-innogames-com.b-cdn.net) and cdn.bsky.app (bsky.b-cdn.net), as the last name of the chain
